When __you face an extended or complex challenge__, name your objective and choose a rank as appropriate to the situation.

  * You have a clear advantage: Troublesome
  * You are ready to act: Dangerous
  * You are unprepared or outmatched: Formidable

Then, activate a four-segment countdown track and @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.ironsworndolestarmoves.13be249ae65798ac]{Face Danger} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.ironsworndolestarmoves.29d091067086ac7f]{Secure an Advantage} to take action.
